accounting.accountant: GDP composition (Dong, Roth & Su 2019) + analytic Gaussian conversion (Balle & Wang 2018)

privacy_config.accountant_description: T-fold composition of the Gaussian mechanism is exactly mu-GDP with mu = sqrt(T)/z (Dong, Roth & Su 2019); epsilon from the analytic Gaussian conversion (Balle & Wang 2018). RDP (Mironov 2017) reported as an upper-bound cross-check.
privacy_config.clip_scope: All floating-point state entries: conv/linear weights and biases, BatchNorm affine parameters and running statistics
privacy_config.clipping_norm_rationale: Fixed a priori (not tuned on client, validation or test data)
privacy_config.mechanism: DP-FedAvg, client level: per-client L2 clipping of the full floating-point state update, sample-weighted aggregation with fixed public weights, Gaussian noise added once to the aggregate by a trusted server
privacy_config.noise_multiplier_rationale: Smallest two-decimal value meeting target_epsilon at delta over 20 full-participation rounds (GDP accountant requires z >= 2.6843)
privacy_config.privacy_unit_description: All training data of one simulated client (5 clients); add/remove-one-client adjacency with the other clients' aggregation weights held fixed

selection_note: Round selection uses only the validation split, which is not client data; selecting among released models is post-processing.
